text:
maria: Heads-up: planning a late-window rollout for runtime v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 at 02:15 UTC. Need cross-service pin/check: API, console schema, router header split. Please ack and call out blockers.
own: ack. Router header split is scheduled, but need confirmation that console schema change is non-breaking for older runtime. I can hold router if needed.
jin: quick note — runtime v2.4.0 changes KV eviction TTL algo; ops need migration steps in release notes. If we don't pin API->runtime mapping, some requests may hit new behavior.
rami: Agree. Propose: pin API route to runtime v2.3.1 for first 10 minutes, then switch 20% traffic to v2.4.0 canary. Rollback condition: >2% tail p99 increase or error rate spike >0.5% for 5m.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Starting canary: runtime v2.4.0 -> instances: runtime-canaries-02 (3 pods). Traffic split: 0->20% over 10m. See runbook: https://redwood.company/runbooks/runtime-canary
maria: @deploy-bot add pin on API layer: api-route: /v1/generate -> runtime:v2.3.1 (pinned). We'll unpin when 20% stable for 15m.
owen: Console: adding schema compatibility flag OFF for this roll so console reads old shape; patch PR: https://git.internal/console/PR-482. Will watch for missing fields.
sre-oncall: baseline p50/p95/p99 before cut: 18ms/120ms/480ms. Set alert mute for preflight logs to avoid noise. If p99 >600ms or 10% increase from baseline, initiate rollback.
jin: Also add KV cache warmup in release notes: run `scripts/warm_kv.sh` against canary group to avoid cold misses.
rami: release notes draft: "runtime v2.4.0: KV TTL adjustment, perf improvements for attention kernel; requires API pin during canary; follow warm_kv.sh before traffic migration. Rollback criteria: p99 or error-rate as above."
maria: 👍 If no objections, I'll trigger deploy-bot at 02:15 UTC. Owen, can you standby for router pin/unpin? 
owen: On standby. If console reports missing fields, I'll hold router at 0%.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started at 6198765440, traffic ramp schedule applied.
jin: Observability note — add a synthetic prompt with 4 tokens to monitor kv-hit ratio and latency (route: /v1/health-check).
rami: I'll publish release notes + changelog snippet to #release-notes after 02:30 UTC.
maria: thanks team — I'll post final rollout note when we move to 100% or rollback.
